rationale: Repaired and executed the discriminator for @q_snapshot_delta_underflow. The single-node harness now waits for leadership before applying and then compares shouldSnapshot() before and after a user Snapshot() with TrailingLogs=0 and SnapshotThreshold=10000. Native construction feedback with the fixed inputs produced the decisive operands: control (store_last=4, snapshot_index=0, commit=4) should_snapshot=false, and after the snapshot plus compaction (store_last=0, snapshot_index=4, store_emptied=true) should_snapshot=true even though commit and applied index were unchanged at 4. The submission records this as the fixed experiment for controller execution; the measured interpretation is left for the retained receipt.

scope.description: One process, one real single-node cluster with TrailingLogs=0, SnapshotThreshold=10000 and SnapshotInterval=1h. After the node becomes leader two commands are applied, then shouldSnapshot(), the log store's LastIndex, the cached snapshot index and the commit index are recorded (control). A user-triggered Snapshot() is then run, after which the same operands are recorded again along with store_emptied (store last index below the snapshot index).

experiment.prefix: inmemConfig supplies the timing defaults; TrailingLogs=0 makes compactionWithTrailing delete up to the snapshot index and the large SnapshotThreshold makes the threshold test false for the control. MakeCluster(1, t, conf) starts the real node over InmemTransport with InmemStore for logs and stable state; the test polls r.State() for Leader before applying so the apply is accepted by the leader. The observed transition is produced by the production snapshot path (Raft.Snapshot -> runSnapshots -> takeSnapshot -> compactLogs), not by editing or stubbing production logic; shouldSnapshot and the index accessors are package-internal reads of the runtime object.
